refactor(codeoff): split remaining source files over 800 lines by responsibility

Split twelve oversized codeoff modules into focused submodules with
wiring-only entry files (mod.rs, lib.rs, or #[path=...] for integration
tests). No business logic changes; visibility adjusted only where module
nesting required it for compile.

All split files are now under 800 lines. Verified with:
cargo check/test -p codeoff-runtime -p codeoff-mcp -p codeoff-cli --lib
